Andrew Pereira is a senior editor at Encyclopaedia Britannica. And so it has been that some of the most famous exponents of football have never won a FIFA World Cup, the grandest stage of the sport. Here is *Britannica*’s list of 13 famous football players who have never won a World Cup.
